purpose: Installed-Python paired vector-stage recall@10 against same-model exact-f32 neighbors on a fixed 1000-document four-source corpus

corpus.selection_rule: For each source in declared order, parse JSONL, retain nonempty body rows, sort by doc_id, and select the first 250 whose Python json.dumps({summary: source body}) canonical body bytes are unique across all earlier selected sources and this source. Assign logical IDs <source>-000..249 and source IDs slice135-fidelity:<source>.
corpus.query_rule: Within each selected source, choose indices 0,10,...,240. Use a title when trimmed length >=6, not untitled, and not verbatim body; otherwise use the first sentence or 140 characters of cleaned lead text. Target is the selected source body, excluded before top-10 truncation.
corpus.body_uniqueness_rule: Exactly 1000 distinct canonical body SHA-256 values; duplicate bodies are skipped before assigning selection indices and query targets.

vector_stage_isolation: After projection drain and independent same-model embeddings, close the engine, back up the intact SQLite database, delete only rows in search_index, search_index_v2 and search_index_edges in the measurement copy, and reopen. Audit exact canonical rows, unchanged vector storage bytes, pre/post FTS counts and integrity; every scored query must have zero text-only hits and vector-only observed hits. Corpus bodies are unique so one-arm RRF order is rank-equivalent to the pre-fusion vector arm; the auditor rejects any exact-f32 rank inversion.
gold_origin: Brute-force squared L2 over the engine default embedder f32 vectors of the canonical stored JSON bodies and title-or-lead query text; no product search result supplies gold.
scoring_rule: For each query, fold squared L2 in f32 over 384 dimensions, order by (distance, body SHA-256), exclude all copies of the target body and deduplicate by body before exact top 10. From up to 15 ordered vector-stage hits, exclude target and duplicate bodies before taking 10. Recall@10 is intersection size divided by 10 even if fewer than 10 hits remain. Report 100 per-query values, each version mean and paired candidate-minus-baseline mean.
uncertainty_rule: Deterministic paired bootstrap of 100 query deltas with replacement, 2000 resamples, seed 135, percentile 2.5% and 97.5%; descriptive uncertainty, no automatic superiority claim.
omission_rule: No query, source, wheel, database, or version may be omitted or replaced; an incomplete or malformed pair invalidates the fidelity cell. A short valid product result stays in the fixed denominator and scores lower. If lexical isolation, body uniqueness, monotonic vector rank or model identity fails, report this cell unsupported until repaired; never score hybrid or duplicate-boosted one-arm output against vector gold.
license_boundary: Cached source JSONL, canonical body text, title-or-lead queries, raw databases and derived vectors remain local and outside Git. The Git protocol and report contain source hashes, nonverbatim metadata and aggregate metrics only. Enron is research-use; MIT and Apache-2.0 sources retain their source licenses.
version_pairing: Two fresh SQLite databases, same selected source bytes, model identity, query set, vector-stage isolation, K and result limit; baseline and candidate wheel/native bytes verified against source SHAs. No same-database reuse.
model_assets_rule: Use the default Candle BGE loader at the pinned Hugging Face revision; its source-pinned config, tokenizer and safetensors checksums are verified by the selected wheel. The installed wheel/native hashes and engine-reported model name bind this run.
supersession_reason: The first 1000-row attempt contained two duplicate canonical bodies. One-arm RRF accumulated duplicate contributions, so clearing FTS alone did not reproduce pre-fusion vector order for three queries. V2 selects 1000 globally unique bodies and audits exact-f32 rank monotonicity.
